The Entegra is the only class C on the market to minimize 'road fatigue' through construction and materials. The standard features list is nothing short of extraordinary including a one-piece seamless molded fiberglass front cap with fiberglass wings, an automotive and bonded panoramic front window with power black-out interior shade and a full aluminum front cab-over cage for superior strength and coach integrity.
